# Eval Question Catalog

This page lists all **eval questions** that an LLM sub-agent answers during a
grading. **Not to be confused with the
[Code Test Catalog](./test-catalog.md)** — which lists the Jest tests that protect
the engine itself.

| Stats | Value |
|-------|------|
| Areas active | 10 (Area 7 with L1/L2/L3) |
| Total questions | 60 |

| Non-deterministic | 53 |

| Persona required | 35 |

## Area 1 — single-test

| ID | Question | Dimension | Determinism | Persona |
|----|----------|-----------|-------------|---------|
| `Q-single-test-01` | Is the tool's docs URL reachable with an HTTP 200 status? | `docsUrlReachable` | deterministic | no |
| `Q-single-test-02` | Does the output schema match the tool's real test response? | `outputSchemaMatch` | deterministic | no |
| `Q-single-test-03` | Does the API key domain match the provider domain in the schema? | `apiKeyDomainMatch` | deterministic | no |
| `Q-single-test-04` | Is the tool description free of marketing terms? | `descriptionClarity` | non-deterministic | no |
| `Q-single-test-05` | Does the description follow the specification's conventions (third person, no promotional copy)? | `descriptionSpecConformance` | non-deterministic | no |
| `Q-single-test-06` | Are the parameter names consistent (snake_case vs. camelCase)? | `paramConsistency` | non-deterministic | no |
| `Q-single-test-07` | Are the example inputs realistic and usable? | `exampleQuality` | non-deterministic | no |
| `Q-single-test-08` | Is the tool name semantically clear (no abbreviation without explanation)? | `toolNameSemantic` | non-deterministic | no |
| `Q-single-test-09` | Are the error cases (4xx/5xx) documented in the schema? | `errorCasesDocumented` | non-deterministic | no |
| `Q-single-test-10` | Is the verb prefix of the tool name consistent (get/list/search)? | `verbPrefixConsistent` | non-deterministic | no |
